notes: Chevening (UK FCDO) government professional fellowship, six weeks, non-degree, for mid-career defence/security professionals; no professor or supervisor structure and no faculty attached. Official Chevening page (https://www.chevening.org/fellowship/chevening-europe-defence-and-security-fellowship) repeatedly timed out on direct fetch; content captured via live web search of the official domain: 'The Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship is funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and delivered by Cranfield University at the Defence Academy of the United Kingdom, Shrivenham... Through six weeks of teaching, discussion, practical exercises, site visits, individual research, and collaborative learning...' No professors named. Cranfield Defence and Security pages (cranfield.ac.uk/defence-and-security) list centres and staff but no faculty tied to this fellowship. Delivering institution is a delivery arrangement only, like Fulbright-type government schemes; classified not_applicable per the government-scheme rule.

Foundation-administered scholarship (Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation) with no attached institution: applicants choose any Canadian university. Official eligibility page (https://www.trudeaufoundation.ca/become-a-scholar/) states: 'To be eligible, you must be one of the following: A Canadian student enrolled at a Canadian university; A Canadian student enrolled at a university outside Canada; or An international student enrolled at a Canadian university' and applicants must be 'in the first year of a PhD program; or in the second year of a PhD program'. One reference must come 'from your PhD supervisor' - the applicant's own supervisor, not a professor attached to the scholarship. No professors named on official Foundation pages (2027 Applications: https://www.trudeaufoundation.ca/2027-applications; programme contact scholarship2027@trudeaufoundation.ca is a foundation mailbox). Classified not_applicable.

Government of Alberta provincial agency programme (Alberta Innovates) delivered through five participating post-secondary institutions, with no supervising professors attached. Official page (https://albertainnovates.ca/programs/graduate-student-scholarships) states: 'This scholarship program is open to Canadian, permanent resident, and international graduate students conducting full-time research in key emerging technology areas... at one of the following post-secondary institutions' (Athabasca University, Concordia University of Edmonton, University of Alberta, University of Calgary, University of Lethbridge) and 'Each of the participating Alberta institutions has scholarship application and evaluation processes specific to their institutions for students in programs of full-time study.' Programme contact Kartavi Shah is a business partner at the agency, not an academic supervisor. Classified not_applicable.

Political foundation (CSU-affiliated Hanns-Seidel-Stiftung e.V.) scholarship for studies/PhD at a university chosen by the applicant; no professors attached. Official criteria page (https://www.hss.de/stipendium/wen-suchen-wir) requires the applicant to be 'admitted to a state or state-recognized university or research institution in Germany' (Scholarship for PhDs and research fellowships) or to 'complete a full-time course of study at a state or state-recognized university in Germany' (Scholarship for Studies). Only named person is Dr Jutta Moehringer, 'Leiterin Institut fuer Begabtenfoerderung' (institute head / scholarship administrator, contact studienfoerderung@hss.de) - a foundation administrator, not a research supervisor, so not recorded as a professor. Classified not_applicable.

Party foundation (SPD-affiliated Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung e.V.) doctoral scholarship for candidates admitted to a German university of their own choice; no professors attached. Official page (https://www.fes.de/studienfoerderung/stipendium/promotionsfoerderung-fuer-auslaender-innen) states: 'Die Promotionsfoerderung fuer Auslaender:innen richtet sich an Promovierende an einer deutschen Hochschule' (targets doctoral candidates at a German university of their choosing). The page's named contacts are scholarship counsellors Elisabeth Schulze Horn and Rebecca Schmitz (fes.de), i.e. programme administrators rather than professors; not recorded as professors. Classified not_applicable.

French national research-funding call (ANR, France 2030 / PEPR 'Grands Fonds Marins', coordinated with CNRS, Ifremer, IRD). Official call page (https://anr.fr/fr/france-2030/france2030/call/france-2030-pepr-gfm-grands-fonds-marins-appel-a-projets-2026) funds research consortia, not students with supervisors: 'Les beneficiaires des aides seront des etablissements d'enseignement superieur et/ou de recherche. Les entreprises et les etablissements etrangers pourront avoir le statut d'etablissement partenaire...' Projects run 36-54 months at 800 kEUR-3 M EUR within an envelope of ~17.5 M EUR. No supervising professors attached; the only contact is the programme mailbox PEPR-GrandsFondsMarins@anr.fr. Classified not_applicable (government research grant with no attached professors).

French national research-funding call (ANR, France 2030 / PEPR PROPSY 'Psychiatrie de precision', piloted by Inserm and CNRS in partnership with Fondation FondaMental, EUR 80 M over 7 years). Official call page (https://anr.fr/fr/france-2030/france2030/call/france-2030-pepr-propsy-psychiatrie-de-precision-appel-a-projets-2026) funds precision-psychiatry research projects (pre-clinical, clinical, trials, mixed), not doctoral candidates with supervisors: 'Les beneficiaires des aides sont les organismes de recherche, les etablissements d'enseignement superieur et de recherche.' Projects run 24-48 months (pre-clinical) or 36-48 months (clinical/mixed); total envelope EUR 9.6 M for this call. No supervising professors attached; only contact is the programme mailbox PEPR-PROPSY@anr.fr. Classified not_applicable (government research grant with no attached professors).
